about: Corporate actions confirmed from the issuer's own filing. Merging a change to this file is the confirmation: scripts/repair_corporate_actions.py writes each row into _Corporate_Actions on or after its effective date (never before, so prices are not rebased early) and repairs Performance_Log. Ratio follows core/corporate_actions.py: SPLIT r = r-for-1, REVERSE_SPLIT r = 1-for-r. Effective date = the first session priced on the new basis.
